title: Waikiki Turtle Snorkeling Tour 6 Activities + & Sunset Cruise
includes: Pickup and drop off (Pickup service is available only within the Waikiki area.)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Infants under 24 months may board free of charge but must be accompanied by an adult, and entering the water is not permitted.
Cancellation/Refund Policy: Cancellations made within 2 days of departure (including same day) are non-refundable.

First-time snorkelers and less-confident swimmers are welcome. Life jackets are provided, and our experienced crew can assist guests in the water using flotation boards, helping you enjoy the snorkeling experience more comfortably and confidently.
Guests who are prone to motion sickness are advised to take motion sickness medication before boarding.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our Sunset Turtle Snorkeling Tour offers a unique all-in-one Waikiki ocean experience, combining adventure, relaxation, and a beautiful Hawaiian sunset in one unforgettable trip.

Start your adventure at Turtle Canyon, where you can snorkel with Hawaiian green sea turtles and tropical fish. Enjoy even more ocean fun with kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding, sea scooters, and swimming—all included at no additional cost.

After snorkeling, cruise along the beautiful Waikiki coastline and take in panoramic views of Waikiki Beach, Diamond Head, and the Honolulu skyline.

As the sun begins to set over the Pacific Ocean, relax on board and enjoy charcuterie, cocktails, snacks, and drinks while taking in the breathtaking sunset views.

From swimming with sea turtles to ending the evening with a Waikiki sunset, this tour brings together some of Hawaii’s most memorable ocean experiences in one adventure.
